interface: process_frame(frame,index) -> edited BGR frame; input unmodified; all other frame indices return an identical copy
geometry: Fresh red-strip quad detection in each frame, not a fixed screen rectangle. Exact master is projected in a 2:1 depth-compressed sheet plane. Narrow exposed fragments clip the same-size print instead of squeezing in a miniature whole word.
foreground: Cross-strip neutral machinery plus a local boundary-connected dark nonred matte on already detected near-left narrow fragments; original source foreground restored exactly.
pixelTestInterpretation: Isolated originally pale pixels can equal newly rendered paper or antialias colors by coincidence; the few unchanged samples do not preserve an original letter shape.

resolvedDefects: Narrow red decorative border false positives excluded
Motion-blurred light print need not be a hole in the red mask
Low-contrast middle-row print uses solid-brand-strip geometry fallback
Short partly occluded label pieces have a separate thickness threshold
Partial print entering at the frame edge is covered
Partial exposure clips the existing master at the normal plane size
Near-left narrow exposure is cut along original diagonal rail instead of painting the dark foreground corner

remainingParentWork: Compose with the final Holiland shot helper
Encode full-length output with original timing/audio
Review the complete encoded video in normal playback before publication
limitations: Original early-shot brand cannot be transcribed reliably because of shallow focus; no invented transcription is used.
Tiny far or occluded fragments keep source-scale blur. This is authored planar branding, not a claim of calibrated 3D reconstruction.
